package main

import (
    "iter"
    "runtime"
    "time"
    _ "unsafe"
    "go.bytecodealliance.org/pkg/wit/async"
)

//go:wasmimport fixture [async-lower]wait
func fixtureWait() uint32

//go:wasmimport fixture observe
func observe(kind, value uint32)

//go:linkname activationFinish runtime.lsfActivationFinish
func activationFinish()

func boolValue(value bool) uint32 {
    if value { return 1 }
    return 0
}

func resetPair(channelTimer bool) {
    var timer *time.Timer
    stopped := make(chan struct{})
    if channelTimer {
        timer = time.NewTimer(10 * time.Millisecond)
        go func() {
            select {
            case <-timer.C: observe(6, 1)
            case <-stopped:
            }
        }()
    } else {
        timer = time.AfterFunc(10 * time.Millisecond, func() { observe(30, 1) })
    }
    async.SubtaskWait(fixtureWait())
    started := make(chan struct{})
    done := make(chan struct{}, 2)
    go func() {
        close(started)
        result := timer.Reset(time.Hour)
        observe(1, boolValue(result))
        done <- struct{}{}
    }()
    <-started
    go func() {
        if channelTimer {
            result := timer.Reset(2 * time.Hour)
            observe(2, boolValue(result))
        } else {
            result := timer.Stop()
            observe(2, boolValue(result))
        }
        done <- struct{}{}
    }()
    <-done
    <-done
    if channelTimer {
        result := timer.Stop()
        observe(3, boolValue(result))
        close(stopped)
    }
}

func afterFunc() {
    completed := make(chan struct{})
    var timer *time.Timer
    timer = time.AfterFunc(10 * time.Millisecond, func() {
        observe(10, 1)
        result := timer.Reset(time.Hour)
        observe(11, boolValue(result))
        close(completed)
    })
    <-completed
    result := timer.Stop()
    observe(12, boolValue(result))
}

func channelFire() {
    timer := time.NewTimer(10 * time.Millisecond)
    <-timer.C
    observe(20, 1)
    result := timer.Reset(time.Hour)
    observe(21, boolValue(result))
    result = timer.Stop()
    observe(22, boolValue(result))
}

func idleDrain() {
    timer := time.NewTimer(10 * time.Millisecond)
    stopWatcher := make(chan struct{})
    watcherDone := make(chan struct{})
    go func() {
        select {
        case <-timer.C: observe(46, 1)
        case <-stopWatcher:
        }
        close(watcherDone)
    }()
    async.SubtaskWait(fixtureWait())
    close(stopWatcher)
    <-watcherDone
    observe(40, 1)
    activationFinish()
    observe(41, 1)
    runtime.KeepAlive(timer)
}

// Exercise the standard library coroutine path with the ordinary v7 owners.
func iteratorTurn() {
    observe(50, 0)
    next, stop := iter.Pull(func(yield func(uint32) bool) {
        observe(52, 0)
        if !yield(42) { observe(55, 0); return }
        yield(43)
    })
    observe(51, 0)
    value, ok := next()
    if !ok { panic("iterator produced no value") }
    observe(53, value)
    stop()
    observe(54, 0)
    activationFinish()
}

//go:wasmexport begin
func begin(mode uint32) uint32 {
    return async.Run(func() {
        switch mode {
        case 1: resetPair(true)
        case 2: afterFunc()
        case 3: channelFire()
        case 4: resetPair(false)
        case 5: idleDrain()
        case 6: resetPair(true)
        case 7: iteratorTurn()
        default: panic("unknown mode")
        }
    })
}

//go:wasmexport resume
func resume(event, id, status uint32) uint32 {
    return async.Callback(event, id, status)
}

func main() {}
